# Number 8 AI

> A hand-checked directory of AI tools for New Zealand small businesses — from Xero-friendly bookkeeping to AI receptionists for tradies and cafés. Filter by what you need, see pricing notes and NZ-made picks.

Website: https://j7524rdvdb-eng.github.io/number8ai/
Last updated: 2026-10-15
Machine-readable data: https://j7524rdvdb-eng.github.io/number8ai/tools.json

Notes: Pricing is as shown on each provider's site when checked and may be in USD or exclude GST; "See site" means unverified. "NZ-made" means founded in or based in New Zealand.

## Accounting & bookkeeping
Category page: https://j7524rdvdb-eng.github.io/number8ai/category/accounting/
- [Xero (JAX)](https://www.xero.com/nz/ai-in-accounting/jax/): Cloud accounting with JAX, an AI companion that answers money questions, drafts quotes and invoices and helps with day-to-day bookkeeping. Pricing: JAX features listed as included with Xero plans; one-month-free offer shown on site. See site for plan prices. NZ notes: NZ-made — founded in Wellington.
- [Dext](https://dext.com/): AI-powered capture of receipts, bills and invoices, with the data pushed straight into your books. Pricing: Free trial; see site for NZ pricing. NZ notes: Integrates with Xero.
- [Lightyear](https://www.lightyear.cloud/): AI accounts-payable automation: extracts line items from supplier bills, codes them and syncs them to your accounting software. Pricing: Free trial; see site. NZ notes: Integrates with Xero (listed on the Xero App Store NZ).
- [Spotlight Reporting](https://www.spotlightreporting.com/): Management reporting, dashboards and cash-flow forecasting, with AI-assisted report commentary. Pricing: Free trial; see site. NZ notes: NZ-made — founded in Wellington. Integrates with Xero.
- [Aider](https://www.aider.ai/): AI platform for accountants and bookkeepers that automates period close, flags anomalies and produces AI management reports for clients. Pricing: From NZ$150/month minimum + GST, 12-month commitment (as stated on site). NZ notes: NZ-made — based in Takapuna, Auckland. Connects to Xero; NZD pricing.

## Marketing & social
Category page: https://j7524rdvdb-eng.github.io/number8ai/category/marketing/
- [Canva](https://www.canva.com/): Design platform with Canva AI for generating images, copy and on-brand social graphics. Pricing: Free to get started; paid plans — see site.
- [Buffer](https://buffer.com/): Schedule social posts and create, refine and repurpose captions with Buffer's AI Assistant. Pricing: Free forever plan available (as stated on site).
- [Hootsuite](https://www.hootsuite.com/): Social media management with built-in AI tools for writing posts and planning content. Pricing: Free trial; see site.
- [Mailchimp](https://mailchimp.com/): Email and SMS marketing with AI tools to help write and optimise campaigns. Pricing: Free plan and free trial mentioned on site; see site for pricing.
- [Ocoya](https://www.ocoya.com/): AI-generated social posts, captions and graphics, plus scheduling across your channels. Pricing: From $29/month, free trial (as shown on site).
- [Blaze](https://www.blaze.ai/): AI marketing assistant that plans and creates on-brand content for small businesses. Pricing: Free trial; software from $79/month (as shown on site).
- [Yabble](https://www.yabble.com/): AI market research — test ideas on virtual audiences and turn customer feedback into insights fast. Pricing: From US$800/month (as stated on site). NZ notes: NZ-made — Auckland-based.

## Customer service & chat
Category page: https://j7524rdvdb-eng.github.io/number8ai/category/customer-service/
- [Tidio](https://www.tidio.com/): Live chat plus Lyro, an AI agent that answers customer questions on your website. Pricing: Free to start; free trial available.
- [Intercom (Fin)](https://www.intercom.com/): Customer service platform with Fin, an AI agent that resolves customer questions across chat and email. Pricing: From $19 per seat/month + $0.99 per Fin outcome (as shown on site); free trial.
- [Chatbase](https://www.chatbase.co/): Build an AI support agent trained on your own website, FAQs and documents. Pricing: Free trial; see site.
- [Zendesk](https://www.zendesk.com/): AI-powered help desk for handling customer enquiries across email, chat and phone. Pricing: 14-day free trial (as stated on site).

- [Jasper](https://www.jasper.ai/): AI marketing content platform for producing on-brand copy at scale. Pricing: Free trial; see site.

## Tradies & quotes
Category page: https://j7524rdvdb-eng.github.io/number8ai/category/trades/
- [Tradify](https://www.tradifyhq.com/nz/features/smarttools): Job management for tradies with SmartTools AI — reads supplier bills from photos and writes quote and invoice descriptions. Pricing: 14-day free trial; see site for plans. NZ notes: NZ-made. Integrates with Xero.
- [Fergus](https://fergus.com/nz/assistant/): Job management for trades businesses with Fergus Assistant — create jobs, quotes and invoices by talking or typing. Pricing: Free trial; see site. NZ notes: NZ-made — Auckland-based, with NZ support team.
- [ServiceM8](https://www.servicem8.com/): Job management app for trade and service businesses, with AI features for quotes, notes and invoices. Pricing: Free trial; see site. NZ notes: Integrates with Xero.

Pricing: See site NZ notes: Operates in NZ with an NZ subsidiary (Now Book It Limited, Auckland).

## Admin, meetings & automation
Category page: https://j7524rdvdb-eng.github.io/number8ai/category/admin/
- [Otter.ai](https://otter.ai/): AI meeting agent that takes notes, transcribes and summarises your meetings. Pricing: Free Basic plan; Business from $19.99/user/month (as shown on site).
- [Fathom](https://www.fathom.ai/): AI notetaker that records, transcribes and summarises your calls. Pricing: Free forever plan (as stated on site).
- [Zapier](https://zapier.com/): Automate workflows between thousands of apps, with AI steps and agents. Pricing: Free to start; see site.
- [Notion AI](https://www.notion.com/product/ai): Notes, docs and wikis with AI built in to search, summarise and write. Pricing: See site
- [Fyxer](https://www.fyxer.com/): AI email assistant that organises your inbox, drafts replies and takes meeting notes. Pricing: 14-day free trial (as stated on site).

## Legal, HR & payroll
Category page: https://j7524rdvdb-eng.github.io/number8ai/category/legal-hr/
- [Employment Hero](https://employmenthero.com/nz/): AI-powered HR, payroll, hiring and rostering in one platform. Pricing: See site NZ notes: Has a dedicated New Zealand product and site.
- [PayHero](https://www.payhero.co.nz/): Payroll and time tracking, with a Claude AI connector so you can ask questions about your payroll in plain English. Pricing: 14-day free trial (as stated on site). NZ notes: NZ-made payroll software (by FlexiTime). Integrates with Xero.
- [Spellbook](https://www.spellbook.com/): AI contract drafting and review for lawyers and businesses. Pricing: 7-day free trial (as stated on site).
- [VXT](https://www.vxt.ai/): Phone system with AI call notes and summaries, built for lawyers and professional services. Pricing: See site NZ notes: NZ-made — NZ startup (NZVC portfolio company).
